STATE OF WAR [BETA]

Build a city. Raise an army. Launch the missiles.

BUILD
Start with an empty island and grow it into a nation.

FIGHT
Research missiles, set up air defences and strike rival nations.

CONQUER
Send ground forces to capture the Centre Island’s cities, labs and rare mines.

PEACEFUL?
Turn PvP off and just build.

BETA
